questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: Why smog is so common in Chinese cities
Whether the USA and China can work together
How the Paris agreement was written
The history of greenhouse gases
questions.why: Rob says they'll discuss whether the two biggest emitters, the USA and China, can work together.

questions.q: What did countries promise under the Paris deal of 2015?
options: To stop using all fossil fuels completely by 2020
To meet every year in Paris to check on progress
To return every five years with bigger plans to cut carbon
To pay China to reduce the pollution from its factories
questions.why: Rob says they promised to come back every five years and raise their carbon-cutting ambitions.

questions.q: What has happened to the USA's place in the Paris agreement?
options: It was never part of it
It left under Biden and returned under Trump
It has always stayed in without any change
Trump took it out, and Biden brought it back in
questions.why: Neil says President Trump pulled out, but President Biden has brought the USA back into it.

questions.q: What has President Xi Jinping promised?
options: China will be carbon neutral by 2060
China will stop all pollution by 2030
China will create 10 million green jobs
China will leave the Paris agreement
questions.why: Rob says Xi Jinping has pledged the country will be carbon neutral by 2060.

questions.q: According to Vincent Ni, what is the paradox in China today?
options: It is rich but has many poor cities
It leads on green projects but is also a big polluter
It wants to work with the USA but refuses to meet
It has clean air but dirty water
questions.why: He says China is leading on green initiatives while also being a big polluter and emitter.

questions.q: What else must China do while fighting pollution, according to Vincent Ni?
options: Reduce poverty
Build more cities
Grow more food
Stop trading with the USA
questions.why: He says China has got to alleviate poverty as well as fight pollution.

questions.q: What historical fact does Jerry Brown admit about the USA?
options: It invented most clean energy technology
It has always polluted less than Europe
It signed the first climate agreement
It has emitted more gases than China
questions.why: He says 'We have put more heat-trapping gases in the atmosphere… than China has'.

questions.q: What does Jerry Brown think the USA should do?
options: Focus on China's mistakes and make China pay for them
Deal with climate change on its own, without other countries
Stop blaming others and work with other countries as partners
Compete with China to be the greenest country in the world
questions.why: He says we need to stop pointing fingers and work with China, Russia and Europe as partners.
